name: @bergaaberg/peak
description: peak.yaml: one small file per repo that tells people and coding agents what the repo is, what owns what, and what to read first.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- dist)"
